chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from 'Is ibn al-Qasim, who said:
I asked Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام about a man who catches one takbir of the prayer over the deceased. He said: He completes what remains.

key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ عَلَى الْمَيِّتِ: the funeral prayer performed over the deceased
key_terms.تَكْبِيرَةً: one utterance of takbir within the funeral prayer
key_terms.يُدْرِكُ: catches up to or joins in time for

ai.seo_question: If someone catches only one takbir of the funeral prayer, should he complete the rest?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about salat over the deceased when a person joins late and catches only one takbir. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام instructs that he should complete the remaining takbirs, showing that what was missed is to be finished.
